title: Supply chain — rogue tools & MCP servers
summary: Module 7. An agent's tools are its supply chain. Register a rogue tool with no manifest and a tampered one that escalates its capabilities, then refuse both with signed manifests and startup attestation.
takeaway: A tool you didn't verify runs with your agent's privileges. Attest before you trust.
design_rule: Signed capability manifests + startup attestation; refuse unverified or over-scoped components.
